segments.script: [EN: Warm up.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: How long, up to now?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Bao lâu rồi?] [EN: Let's go, okay?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mình đi nha.] [EN: I will attend the party.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi sẽ tham gia tiệc.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Tiệc.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Party.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: A get-together is] [VI_F: Họp mặt.] [EN: a family or friends gathering. Say get-together.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Họp mặt.] [EN: This weekend my family has a gathering.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cuối tuần gia đình tôi họp mặt.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Cheerful, or fun, is] [VI_F: Vui vẻ.] [EN: It was very fun.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Vui vẻ lắm.] [EN: Everyone was happy.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mọi người đều vui.] [EN: She said] [VI: mọi người,] [EN: which means everyone. Good.]

[EN: Drill. Get-together.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Họp mặt.] [EN: Cheerful, fun.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Vui vẻ.] [EN: This weekend my family has a gathering.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cuối tuần gia đình tôi họp mặt.] [EN: It was very fun.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Vui vẻ lắm.] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Họp mặt.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Get-together.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Vui vẻ.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Cheerful, fun.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Cuối tuần gia đình mình họp mặt. Vui lắm!] [VI_M: Có đông không?] [VI_F: Đông chứ! Mọi người đều vui vẻ.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Say, this weekend my family has a gathering.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cuối tuần gia đình tôi họp mặt.] [EN: Say, it was very fun.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Vui vẻ lắm.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow is your Level 3 review. The preview phrase is] [VI: ôn tập] [EN: which means to review.]
